118279.name: Chabad of Greater Los Feliz
118279.note: Lubavitch.com (Jan 30 2025, 'Putting Children First: Chabad of Los Feliz, CA Dedicates New Center'): 'Chabad of Los Feliz was founded in 1998 ... From the start, Rabbi Leibel and Dvonye Korf focused on building community—"We taught Hebrew school and hosted prayer services in the living room of our small rental home" ... After a stint operating out of a storefront in a mini-mall, Chabad moved into a larger property at 1930 Hillhurst Ave in 2006. In 2016, Chabad purchased what was then an office building down the block from Children's Hospital Los Angeles.' Kotzk.com (Feb 2018) agrees: by July 1999 it 'was still in the living room'. (therebbesimpact.com: 1997.)

earlier.where: the living room of the Korfs' small rental home (then of their home at 1932 New Hampshire Ave, from July 1999)

118443.name: Chabad of Belmont Shore
118443.note: Its Shul by the Shore's own About page (published May 14 2023): 'The Shul by the Shore has been serving the Jewish community in Long Beach, California for 30 years. Founded by Rabbi Abba Perelmuter', so about 1993. The Long Beach federation's directory (undated) agrees: it 'was started ten years ago by Rabbi Perelmuter, at the High Holidays', and in 2000 'the Shul began to offer full synagogue services' (https://www.jewishlongbeach.org/resources/community-directory/shul-by-the-shore). Both are counts back, so medium. (therebbesimpact.com's 1981 is when the Perelmuters came to Long Beach.) A new building was being fitted out in 2024.

316514.name: Chabad Jewish Center of South Huntington Beach
316514.note: Its own site: 'Chabad of South Huntington Beach was established by Rabbi Yossi and Yiska Berkowitz in 2005'; its Charidy campaign (https://www.charidy.com/chabadshb24): 'established in 2005'. (therebbesimpact.com's 2000 is for the couple.)

545282.name: Chabad of Coronado
545282.note: Coronado Eagle and Journal, July 27 2005 (an ad, California Digital Newspaper Collection): 'Chabad of Coronado Invites you to Shabbat on the Island ... Weekly throughout the summer season ... The Masonic Lodge 529 Orange Avenue ... Rabbi Josef Fradkin of the Chabad Educational Center will conduct warm and inspiring services' (jfradkin@chabadsd.org). Then July 12 2006 ('New Services At Community Ctr.', https://cdnc.ucr.edu/?a=d&d=CJ20060712.2.11): 'Chabad of Coronado has established new, permanent headquarters for the Jewish community ... weekly Sabbath services in the Coronado Community Center, 1845 Strand Way. Chabad kicks off its opening with a community dinner ... Friday, July 21 ... call Rabbi Eli Fradkin'. The 2005 ad is the paper's first mention of Chabad of Coronado (searched 1995-2006), so the start is the summer of 2005; the resident center opened July 21 2006.

earlier.where: summer Shabbat services at the Masonic Lodge, 529 Orange Ave
weekly services at the Coronado Community Center, 1845 Strand Way

2994460.name: Chabad at Pierce
2994460.note: Its own site: 'It was founded in 2015 by the Lubavitcher Rebbe's ambassadors to Pierce College, Rabbi Isser and Mushka Kluwgant' (also https://piercechabadclub.wixsite.com/chabad/about); Chabad.org News, Aug 2015 ('Chabad on Campus Welcomes 20 New Emissary Couples for the Academic Year', https://www.chabad.org/news/article_cdo/aid/3020119): the Kluwgants 'will run programs at Pierce College in Los Angeles'.

3037035.name: Chabad of Eagle Rock and Echo Park
3037035.note: Rabbi Aryeh Perlstein's LinkedIn: Director, Chabad of Eagle Rock & Echo Park, Oct 2015 - Aug 2023. Only LinkedIn, so medium (therebbesimpact.com and the listing number also point to 2015).
